scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('package-lock.json', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('yarn.lock', { force: true }); if (!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('artifacts/app/dist/public', 'public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('artifacts/app/dist/public', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
